description: Minimal capability set for the main Studio window. All privileged operations route through audited #[tauri::command] modules, never raw plugin permissions. The core:window allowances exist solely for the custom chrome (decorations off — see P1.1). The dialog plugin permissions are the native pickers: dialog:allow-open (read-only file selection for asset import, P4.4) and dialog:allow-save (the Save Level As destination picker) — neither grants filesystem access; the chosen path is handed to an audited command.
